annotations.text:
Triage first.

The old screen made you read all five rows to notice two were broken. Status now leads, and each tile filters the table.

Rows that identify themselves.

Five rows called "encounter-start" were indistinguishable. Each row now carries its destination endpoint and its criteria — the things that actually differ.

Failure states earn their weight.

"7" in a plain cell read the same as "0". A failing row now explains what broke, when, whether retries stopped, and offers the fix inline.

Sparklines with a scale.

Unlabelled lines were decoration. These are hourly buckets, red where delivery was failing, with the peak spelled out.
The old table was a dead end — no way to see why something failed. Opening a row shows the remedy first, then the definition, then the actual delivery attempts with status codes and durations.
